evidence.title: Iraq devalues its currency but some MPs oppose it

occurrences.checkable_against: Reuters interview with Iraqi analyst Mohammed al-Saffar
occurrences.quote_span: Speaking to the Reuters news agency, Iraqi analyst Mohammed al-Saffar said the measure “gives the government more dinars for each dollar of oil revenue, but raises import costs and reduces households’ purchasing power”.
occurrences.speaker: Mohammed al-Saffar
occurrences.subject: Iraqi dinar exchange rate

occurrences.checkable_against: Saba al-Saadi's public statement and Iraqi parliament proceedings
occurrences.quote_span: She blamed the Finance Ministry and the CBI for what she called financial mismanagement and vowed to bring the matter before parliament for review.
occurrences.speaker: Saba al-Saadi
occurrences.subject: Iraqi dinar exchange rate

occurrences.checkable_against: Iraq official and parallel foreign-exchange market rate records
occurrences.quote_span: After the new official rate took effect on Wednesday, the rate of the dollar on the parallel market rose as well, with the gap between them widening.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Iraqi dinar exchange rate

occurrences.checkable_against: Statement by Iraqi MP Saba al-Saadi
occurrences.quote_span: MP Saba al-Saadi was also among those who rejected using a weaker dinar to plug the budget gap.
occurrences.speaker: Saba al-Saadi
occurrences.subject: Iraqi dinar exchange rate

occurrences.checkable_against: Statement by Hassan al-Asadi on Iraq's exchange-rate gap
occurrences.quote_span: Al-Asadi called attention to a growing gap between the official and parallel price of dollars in the country, warning it could “inflict severe harm on the poor and vulnerable”.
occurrences.speaker: Hassan al-Asadi
occurrences.subject: Iraqi dinar exchange rate

occurrences.checkable_against: Statements by opposing Iraqi MPs and government payment records
occurrences.quote_span: Opposing MPs criticised the adoption of the measure at a time when Iraqis were already facing rising prices, import fees, taxes, unemployment and delays in government salary and welfare payments.
occurrences.speaker: Opposing Iraqi MPs
occurrences.subject: Iraqi dinar exchange rate

occurrences.checkable_against: Central Bank of Iraq foreign-currency reserve statements
occurrences.quote_span: The lost income has made it harder to pay state salaries and the CBI’s foreign currency reserves fell from about $106bn before the war to roughly $80bn by late August.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Iraqi dinar exchange rate

occurrences.checkable_against: Iraq cabinet decision and Central Bank of Iraq exchange-rate records
occurrences.quote_span: The cabinet approved new exchange rates for the dinar on Tuesday, following an emergency recommendation from Finance Minister Falih al-Sari and the governor of the Central Bank of Iraq (CBI).
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Iraqi dinar exchange rate

occurrences.checkable_against: Central Bank of Iraq foreign-currency reserve statements
occurrences.quote_span: The lost income has made it harder to pay state salaries and the CBI’s foreign currency reserves fell from about $106bn before the war to roughly $80bn by late August.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Iraqi dinar exchange rate

occurrences.checkable_against: Iraq import and consumption statistics
occurrences.quote_span: Iraq relies on imports for much of what it consumes, from food and medicines to raw materials for industry.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Iraqi dinar exchange rate

occurrences.checkable_against: Statement by Hassan al-Asadi and Iraqi parliamentary records
occurrences.quote_span: Hassan al-Asadi, leader of the al-Nahj National Alliance bloc, rejected the measure and suggested alternative methods to balance the budget, such as cutting unnecessary spending.
occurrences.speaker: Hassan al-Asadi
occurrences.subject: Iraqi dinar exchange rate

occurrences.checkable_against: Joint statement by Iraqi MPs and parliamentary records
occurrences.quote_span: In a joint statement on Wednesday, dozens of MPs opposed to the move said they had not been told how or why the decision came about – and that the CBI should have explained it to parliament before it was taken.
occurrences.speaker: Iraqi MPs opposed to the devaluation
occurrences.subject: Iraqi dinar exchange rate

occurrences.checkable_against: Iraqi parliament session agenda and minutes for 2026-10-07
occurrences.quote_span: MPs who opposed the move had the agenda for Wednesday’s session of parliament cancelled in order to debate it instead.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Iraqi dinar exchange rate

occurrences.checkable_against: Central Bank of Iraq statement on the exchange-rate decision
occurrences.quote_span: Iraq’s Central Bank described the decision as a “strategic step” to steady the country’s finances.
occurrences.speaker: Central Bank of Iraq
occurrences.subject: Iraqi dinar exchange rate

occurrences.checkable_against: Al Jazeera interviews with Iraqi consumers and business owners
occurrences.quote_span: Last month, Iraqi consumers and business owners told Al Jazeera that prices had already risen significantly since the Iran war began, on top of delays and disruption to seaborne imports.
occurrences.speaker: Iraqi consumers and business owners
occurrences.subject: Iraqi dinar exchange rate

occurrences.checkable_against: Statement by Iraqi MP Aziz Nasser al-Shammari
occurrences.quote_span: Speaking on their behalf, MP Aziz Nasser al-Shammari, who sits on the Iraqi parliament’s integrity body, denounced the move, saying that they had been “surprised” by the decision.
occurrences.speaker: Aziz Nasser al-Shammari
occurrences.subject: Iraqi dinar exchange rate

occurrences.quote_span: Oil revenues pay for more than 90 percent of Iraq’s federal budget.

occurrences.subject: Iraqi dinar exchange rate

occurrences.subject: Iraqi dinar exchange rate

occurrences.quote_span: From Wednesday, banks and exchange companies have been selling dollars to the public at 1,520 dinars each, 200 higher than the previous price.

occurrences.subject: Iraqi dinar exchange rate

occurrences.quote_span: Last month, Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi said his country was “facing extraordinary economic challenges”, having lost about $60bn in oil revenue as a result of the disruption.
occurrences.speaker: Ali al-Zaidi
occurrences.subject: Iraqi dinar exchange rate

evidence.title: Iraq devalues dinar as Iran war disrupts economy

occurrences.checkable_against: Iraqi banks' foreign-exchange rate schedules
occurrences.quote_span: consumers purchasing from banks will pay 1,520 dinars for a dollar.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Iraqi dinar exchange rate

occurrences.checkable_against: Iraq oil-export and shipping records
occurrences.quote_span: Iraq’s economy relies heavily on oil exports, most of which were shipped via the strait before the war.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Iraqi dinar exchange rate

occurrences.checkable_against: Iraq Finance Ministry and bank foreign-exchange rate schedules
occurrences.quote_span: At the new official rate, Iraq’s Finance Ministry will sell dollars at 1,500 dinars for $1, while consumers purchasing from banks will pay 1,520 dinars for a dollar.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Iraqi dinar exchange rate

occurrences.checkable_against: Iraq oil-export shipping records and overland Syria route records
occurrences.quote_span: Since the war started, Iraq has resorted to shipping oil overland through Syria for export, but the route is more expensive and less efficient.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Iraqi dinar exchange rate

occurrences.checkable_against: Iraq central bank historical exchange-rate records
occurrences.quote_span: The previous exchange rate was set in 2023.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Iraqi dinar exchange rate

occurrences.checkable_against: Iraq central bank statement and Cabinet meeting record
occurrences.quote_span: The country’s central bank said in a statement that the new exchange rate had been decided at a meeting of Iraq’s Cabinet the night before “to meet the relevant financial, economic and monetary requirements.”
occurrences.speaker: Iraq's central bank
occurrences.subject: Iraqi dinar exchange rate

occurrences.checkable_against: Iraqi currency-market exchange-rate records
occurrences.quote_span: After the announcement of the new official exchange rate, the market rate jumped to more than 1,700 dinars to the dollar.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Iraqi dinar exchange rate

occurrences.checkable_against: Iraq Finance Ministry foreign-exchange rate schedule
occurrences.quote_span: Iraq’s Finance Ministry will sell dollars at 1,500 dinars for $1
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Iraqi dinar exchange rate

occurrences.checkable_against: Iraq central bank exchange-rate announcement and official exchange-rate records
occurrences.quote_span: Iraq devalued its currency Wednesday, changing the official exchange rate from around 1,300 Iraqi dinars to the dollar to 1,500 dinars to the dollar.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Iraqi dinar exchange rate

occurrences.checkable_against: Iraqi currency-market exchange-rate records
occurrences.quote_span: The unofficial rate had risen to more than 1,600 dinars to the dollar before the official devaluation was announced.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Iraqi dinar exchange rate

occurrences.checkable_against: Iraqi official and market exchange-rate records plus Strait of Hormuz shipping records
occurrences.quote_span: That gap had widened in recent months as a result of the U.S. war with Iran — which has sometimes spilled over into Iraq — and disruptions to shipping in the Strait of Hormuz.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Iraqi dinar exchange rate
